titulo: Mallory-Weiss Syndrome Without Vomiting Following Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation With a Laryngeal Tube

fig.label: Figure 2
fig.caption: Upper gastrointestinal endoscopic image showing MWSEmergent upper gastrointestinal endoscopy showing a longitudinal mucosal laceration at the gastric cardia (arrow), consistent with MWS. The laceration is located at the esophagogastric junction. The diagnosis was confirmed after contrast-enhanced CT demonstrated active extravasation into the gastric lumen, followed by nasogastric tube insertion yielding a bloody aspirate. Endoscopic clipping was used to achieve hemostasisMWS: Mallory-Weiss syndrome; CT: computed tomography
